- `order_returns`, `order_fees`: as in task 0's file (all six channels' parameters checked).

## Policy-side notes (do not change this skill's verdict)
1. The return reason of a received return authorization is not a field on `order_return_authorizations`; the member pickup fee's prerequisite sentence speaks of "every changed-mind return ... logged as received" while its `condition` checks every received RA regardless of reason. In this world the ottoman's changed-mind nature is inferable from the changed-mind pickup fee charged on it (fees never charged on waived reasons), so solvability is unaffected; noted as a policy-side modelling gap.
2. `order_ext_changed_mind_refund`'s overwrite retires the base per-unit refund clause (adjusted-price and rebate deductions) for the whole `order_returns` policy, while the variant parameter `returned_units_reprice_adjusted` and `order_mail_in_rebates` ("a rebated unit returned later is refunded at its sale price minus the rebate already paid on it") still carry those deductions; the KB renders all three faithfully (retired clause + refund_tender table + mail-in Rule 4). The tension, for non-Special-Order returns, is on the policy side; not a KB defect.
